name: @pipeworx/mcp-chucknorris

tools.name: random_joke
tools.description: Fetch one random Chuck Norris joke from chucknorris.io. Returns joke text, unique ID, category list, and permalink URL.

tools.name: search_jokes
tools.description: Search Chuck Norris jokes by keyword. Returns matching jokes with text and IDs.

query.description: Keyword or phrase to search for within joke text.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all available Chuck Norris joke categories (e.g., 'nerdy', 'sport'). Use with joke_by_category to fetch jokes.

tools.name: joke_by_category
tools.description: Get a random Chuck Norris joke from a specific category. Returns joke text and ID.

category.description: Category to fetch a joke from. Use list_categories to see valid values.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-chucknorris forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the chucknorris pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
